references.claim: A four-stage immature-gametocyte model estimated an 8.39-day sequestration time and showed weak identification of mature lifespan.
A controlled infection study estimated mature female and male gametocyte half-lives of 5.1 and 2.7 days.
Gametocyte production, sequestration and circulation vary substantially between infections.
references.citation: Eichner et al. Transactions of the Royal Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene 2001;95:497-501.
